decision.summary: No new action: the open 79k reach daily remains the right live position, but it is still below partial take-profit territory and there is no second edge with clean expiry timing.
decision.rationale: BTC is holding around 78.76k and the 79k reach daily remains the best same-day expression of the live thesis, with the open position still active and profitable. However, the market is only around 75% probability, still below the playbook partial take-profit band of 80-85%, so there is no reason to reduce yet. Re-adding the same market is unnecessary because the current position already captures the thesis and no materially better re-entry has appeared. With only four hours left until daily close, no secondary setup is clean enough: 80k reach is too stretched for the remaining window, while 78k dip and lower bearish contracts remain out of sync with the neutral-to-firm live structure and lack clean same-day confirmation.
